### Country-specific policy context

<div class="country-policy-context">Seems as though Costa Rica has implemented tafenoquine, being the first country in Central America and the Carribbean implementing tafenoquine.</div>

## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal (>70% enzyme activity)** | TQ or high-dose 7-day PQ | Counselling for adverse events |
| **G6PD normal** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days or PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days if adherence is expected to be low and a risk-benefit analysis is conducted | Counselling for adverse events |
| **G6PD deficient (<30% activity)** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Not specified |
| **if no testing available** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days or PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days if adherence is expected to be low and a risk-benefit analysis is conducted | Not specified |
